name: nx-react-native-cli
description: A react native starter (with NX) cli script

scripts.example: rm -rf example && npm run relink && npx nx-react-native-cli create example com.jeemercado.example --nx-version 21.2.2
scripts.example-fresh: rm -rf example-fresh && npm run relink && npx nx-react-native-cli create example-fresh com.jeemercado.example --fresh --nx-version 21.2.2
scripts.show-diff: npx diff2html -s side --sc --hc --cs light -i file -o preview -F diff.html -- diff.diff && open diff.html
scripts.relink: npm unlink nx-react-native-cli && npm run prepublishOnly && npm link
